data.one_liner: Integrate the CinetPay payment gateway into your Flutter application.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to invoke the CinetPay payment checkout, process payments, and receive real-time payment status updates using callbacks. It renders the payment interface via web views and handles transaction configuration.
use_when: You need to accept payments through CinetPay in your Flutter app.
You want to handle transaction callbacks and error reporting for CinetPay flows.
avoid_when: You are using a payment gateway other than CinetPay.
You require complex, headless payment flows without a built-in checkout widget.
strengths: Provides a ready-to-use checkout widget for CinetPay.
Supports multiple currencies and payment channels like Mobile Money and Wallets.
Offers clear callbacks for both successful payment responses and execution errors.
weaknesses: Requires manual platform-specific configuration for Android and iOS (cleartext traffic / transport security).
Tied exclusively to the CinetPay service.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding INTERNET permission and enabling cleartext traffic in AndroidManifest.xml, setting minimum Android SDK version >= 19 and compileSdk >= 34, and adding NSAppTransportSecurity exceptions in iOS Info.plist.
